transcript.content: What's the warranty on your trekking shoes? The sole is coming off.

Acme Outdoors offers a 6-month warranty on trekking shoes against sole separation and stitching defects.  

To make a claim, please contact our support with:  
- Your order number  
- A description of the defect (e.g., sole coming off)  
- Clear photos of the issue  

Our specialist team will review and either repair, replace, or refund the item. This process usually takes 7–10 business days.  

For further help, you can reach us at [email withheld] or call +91-800-123-4567.
